feeds.title: Vintagerock's Weblog.
feeds.description: I am totally addicted to going to rock concerts. This blog is about creating a permanent record of the gigs that I go to. I have over 1000 ticket snubs for all the rock concerts I have attended. I'll also be including memories of some significant gigs where I don't have a ticket stub, such as club gigs, or gigs where the ticket was given up at the door. Join in as I go down memory lane while still keeping account of gigs and concerts I am attending now.

feeds.title: Ultimate Classic Rock
feeds.description: Ultimate Classic Rock is the world's largest classic rock site, exploring the past, present, and future of music's most legendary and enduring artists. Classic rock music news, interviews, pictures, songs, and lists from classic rock artists.

feeds.title: I Love Classic Rock
feeds.description: I love Classic Rock is here to keep classic rock as relevant and alive in 2019 as ever before. This site was created with the goal of bringing back those classic rock memories, resurfacing rare and old vintage clips of your favorite rock musicians back in the day, and just keeping classic rock alive in general. Here at ILCR, we have content on everything from news to stories to viral Youtube videos. You will find unique editorials on the site and listicles all about classic rock.

feeds.title: Vintage Rock
feeds.description: Vintage Rock is your classic rock magazine with news about rock music, bands, classic rock interviews, rock n roll news and top 100 classic rock songs. Proudly featuring classic rock icons like The Beatles, Rolling Stones, Led Zeppelin, Emerson, Lake & Palmer, Pink Floyd, Deep Purple, The Grateful Dead, The Who, The Eagles, Fleetwood Mac, Jethro Tull, Jimi Hendrix and Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young.

feeds.title: The Diversity of Classic Rock
feeds.description: I'm Angie Moon, the founder of The Diversity of Classic Rock. My goal was to be a classic rock DJ just like my dad, who briefly was a DJ in the 70s. I accidentally became a writer and I found that I loved it because it's something that I'm creating, I'm teaching people, and preserving the knowledge of classic rock history. My blog is a classic rock preservation/appreciation society. A place to rant and rave about classic rock and exchange knowledge.

feeds.title: ClassicRockHistory.com
feeds.description: ClassicRockHistory.com has been developed to offer a subjective and at times objective view of Classic Rock History. ClassicRockHistory.com lists are based on emotion and observation and of course charts. We are attempting to cover every rock and roll band and artist in classic rock history. We have thousands of articles on classic rock album reviews, concert reviews, and various feature articles.

feeds.title: Louder Classic Rock
feeds.description: Classic Rock is a turbo-charged, high-voltage rock'n'rollathon of a magazine. Every month it's packed with exclusive interviews and features on rock's biggest names and includes the heftiest rock reviews section on the planet. In an average issue, you'll find over 150 albums reviewed, all from the ever-varied, multi-faceted world of rock.

feeds.title: Darren's music blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Darren and here at Dareen's music blog find news, reviews, interviews, and more. From classic rock to contemporary folk. I use this blog to post my reviews of many of the gigs I've been to, album reviews, interviews, book reviews, and other music-related posts. I have fairly varied tastes in music: folk, rock, glam, heavy metal, and more.

feeds.title: K-97
feeds.description: K-97 is Edmonton's only true Classic Rock Station; with artists like Pink Floyd, Led Zeppelin, The Rolling Stones, The Who, The Doors, Aerosmith, AC/DC, and more. Launched in May of 1979 K-97 been in Edmonton for over 38 years. Get the latest updates on shows and contests, anecdotes on classic rock music and albums, and more!

feeds.title: Choice Classic Rock Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on all the new releases and news from the world of Choice Classic Rock by reading our Classic Rock music blog. Choice Classic Rock radio is a commercial-free, classic rock internet radio station - streaming music from the Classic Rock decades - for free.

feeds.title: Ticket 2 Ride » Classic Rock
feeds.description: A Kansas native, I grew up in Lawrence, a progressive community, or known by some as the hotbed of radical thought. I am a pop culturalist, mining the 1960s, 1970s and a bit of the 1980s. Follow along as I write about classic rock music and bands, share the nostalgia and recent updates.

feeds.title: Real Rock News
feeds.description: Real Rock News is a dedicated classic‑rock blog delivering the latest news, reviews, concert recaps, and artist updates focused on 'real' rock legends like Bruce Springsteen, AC/DC, Rush, Deep Purple, and more.

feeds.title: The Second Disc » Classic Rock
feeds.description: The Second Disc gives out all the news about music reissues, box sets, and compilations you can stand. Read the classic rock music updates, artists' interviews and information, and more from the industry!

feeds.title: Classic Rock Bob
feeds.description: I am a freelance music journalist with 25+ years of experience writing for newspapers and magazines, largely about classic rock. Read the blogs and follow along as I post my musings on the classic rock music I grew up on.

feeds.title: Listen To The Music Blog
feeds.description: Rediscover the music of your past, or music that perhaps might be new to you, in a manner novel and new. Collections of hits and hidden gems are grouped in fun ways that make you eagerly anticipate every coming playlist and song.

feeds.title: KANSAS
feeds.description: Kansas is an American rock band that became popular during the 1970s initially on album-oriented rock charts and later with hit singles such as 'Carry On Wayward Son' and 'Dust in the Wind'. Here in the blogs get all the latest news and updates on the classic rock band KANSAS Band.

feeds.title: Vintage Rock Magazine
feeds.description: Vintage Rock is the world's best rock'n'roll magazine. Covering the music, artists, lifestyle and culture of the Golden Era from early 50's to mid-60's, the magazine also brings you bang up-to-date with current releases, tours and revivals of classic artists and those paying homage to our heroes.

feeds.title: Live Music Blog » Classic Rock
feeds.description: Live Music Blog's 'Classic Rock' section is a curated feed of news, tour announcements, cover releases, and features focused on the legends and latest happenings in timeless rock music.

feeds.title: Trinkelbonker » Classic Rock
feeds.description: Posts about Classic Rock written by Mike Eriksson

feeds.title: The Classic Machines » Classic Rock
feeds.description: Posts about Classic Rock written by Rubens Junior

feeds.title: Classic Christian Rock Zine
feeds.description: Classic Christian Rock Zine, is an independent webzine that started in March 2011 as a Facebook page. Later we would have a presence on Twitter and Instagram, in 2013 we launched our own website where we started writing our own articles. As the name of our site indicates, our webzine shares articles related to artists who fit directly or indirectly with the phrase 'Classic Christian Rock'. We are (as far as we know) the only webzine that shares news and articles exclusively from classical rock artists with Christian lirycs.

feeds.title: RockDoc Music Courses
feeds.description: Rock Doc Music Courses were founded by 'The Rock Doc' (AKA Dr. Rob Brosh) to provide a fun and highly educational experience for rock music enthusiasts of all ages and music backgrounds. Collectively, our courses will cover every genre and style of rock music! Our articles contain a wealth of information and the history of some of the most iconic rock artists and bands of all time!

feeds.title: Albums That Time Forgot
feeds.description: I am Chris Capelle - a published author, technology expert and music blogger. I decided to dedicate a blog that reviews albums that have largely been forgotten, whether it's been overshadowed by a more popular album by the same artist (No Prayer For The Dying by Iron Maiden), or a forgotten band (Mr. Mister). Some of the posts will be standard album reviews, while others will be thoughts on a particular topic or theme.

feeds.title: Vintage Rock Posters Blog
feeds.description: Vintage Rock Posters offers cash rewards for original Bob Dylan, Elvis Presley, Rolling Stones, Jimi Hendrix, and Buddy Holly rock concert posters. Promoters used these posters to sell tickets and to promote concerts. Find some of the forgotten and still-known posters of the classic rock era.

feeds.title: Old Time Rock and Roll Blog
feeds.description: Old Time Rock and Roll Blog is about the history of Rock and Roll music. My name is Victoria Shaffer. I'm a music journalist and rock n' roll history fanatic. You will find the best Classic Rock Music blogs from thousands of blogs on the web.

feeds.title: Classic Rock Review
feeds.description: Classic Rock Review is the home of forgotten music. Here at Classic Rock Review, we are finding old reviews before they're lost. Explore the reviews on classic rock music from popular old rock music websites.

feeds.title: Stingray
feeds.description: Stingray is proud to provide a wide range of music streaming services for all tastes. Our music services are offered on a variety of platforms to connect with customers anywhere, anytime. Browse through our archive of classic rock for news, interviews, concert clips and photos and more!

feeds.title: Best Classic Bands
feeds.description: Best Classic Bands, where we celebrate the artists, music, and pop culture of the classic rock era. We merge the best aspects of superior rock journalism with the vitality of the digital age to provide a comprehensive and authoritative online resource, news hub, and lifestyle destination for followers. Find Classic Rock Music, Features, Reviews, Breaking News, Interviews, and more!

feeds.title: Classicrockmusicblog.com
feeds.description: I started ClassicRockMusicBlog.com to share my passion for great music with others. Although classic rock is the main player here, you'll also find my favorite blues, folk, jazz and reggae music. This is a music resource for the best classic rock, classic rock songs, bands and artists featuring Classic rock bands, music, songs, LPs, CDs, DVDs and interviews.

feeds.title: Sirius XM Blog » Classic Rock
feeds.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SIRI) is the leading audio entertainment company in North America. SiriusXM offers unique programming and content across the company's subscription- and digital advertising-supported audio platforms. Get the latest updates on classic rocks, polls, listings and more!
